Name: Beach Import Ship
Author: BananaJoq
Description:
[size=5]Description[/size]
Beach Import Ship adds an import freighter shop on the beach. Talk to the clerk to board the ship and browse rental tools, black-market coal, seeds, and custom foods.

[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]You should see two folders: [font=Courier New]BeachImportShip[/font] and [font=Courier New]BeachImportShip.Actions[/font].[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Main features[/size]
[list]
[*]Beach clerk NPC — talk and choose to board the import ship.[/*]
[*]Tool rentals (steel / iridium) for 2 days, clearly labeled as rentals in the shop.[/*]
[*]Black-market coal with random daily stock.[/*]
[*]Ancient Seeds, Rare Seeds, and four custom food items with buffs.[/*]
[*]Shop tabs: Rentals / Black Market / Items.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Shout outs[/size]
Thanks to the Stardew modding community, SMAPI, and Content Patcher.
